newsitem.title: ITALY: Imi, ABN AMRO buy Venice Airport stake.
newsitem.headline: Imi, ABN AMRO buy Venice Airport stake.

text.p: Italian investment bank Imi, Dutch bank ABN AMRO NV AND Efibanca, a unit of Banca Nazionale del Lavoro, have bought Nordest Avio SpA, the company which owns 20 percent of Venice airport.
A statement from Imi gave no financial details and said only that Efibanca had taken a lesser stake than the other partners.
Investment sources said Imi and ABN AMRO would hold more than 60 percent of Nordest.
Venice's Marco Polo airport had passenger traffic of 2.7 million in 1996 and turnover of 94 billion lire. Net profit was more than 12 billion lire, the statement said.
It said the new shareholders would support programmes to boost the airport's growth ahead of a planned 1998 flotation.
